findings.title: Stale 'id' key after charge() rename
findings.description: gateway.charge() no longer returns an 'id' key (renamed to 'charge_id' in this diff), but send_receipt still reads result['id'], raising KeyError after the customer has already been charged; update it to charge_id.
findings.suggestion: Read result['charge_id'] here (and grep for other consumers of charge()'s result).
